name: Google Calendar Entity
description: Displays Google Calendar events as a Drupal content entity/agenda, fetched via the Google Calendar API.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 GCal Entity provides an easy way to display Google calendar events in an agenda format. Events are displayed in a simple agenda list format, with date and event title. 

 Inspired by the D7 agenda module .

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Dupal 8.6.x or higher 
 Google Calendar API key (free) 
 Google Calendar to be shown must be set to PUBLIC 
 
 See the README for more details on configuration and usage.

 Back to top 

 Examples 
 An example of the project in use can be seen at https://www.bloomington.k12.mn.us (district page and all school landing pages). In this project a twig file and some theme hooks were used to generate additional pages with embedded iFrames of the actual Google calendar.

 Back to top
